title: Templars persecuted by Philip the Fair and burned in 1307

tellings.quote: spitting on the cross. And they all ended up getting burnt at the stake in 1307.

plain: The Knights Templar, a medieval order of knights, were accused of rites such as spitting on the cross, and in 1307 they were persecuted by the French king Philip the Fair and burned at the stake. Michels tells this himself, in a passage where he also mentions the thinker Rudolf Steiner, and he names no source for the details.
